resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g., CP2K, ORCA, Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Any DFT code that supports LDA (VWN) optimization and GGA (PW91) vibrational analysis is acceptable.

resources.notes: Original paper used DMol³; an open-source equivalent is used here.

resources.name: Literature activation energies for SiH4-C3H8-H2 system reactions

access.notes: Provided as a CSV file containing reaction identifiers and their literature Ea values (extracted from Ref. [3] in the paper).

resources.notes: Used to establish the LFER correlation together with DFT-computed ΔG values.

resources.name: Molecular structures for gas-phase species

access.notes: Provided as an XYZ file or SMILES list containing the initial molecular coordinates/connectivity for all required species.

resources.notes: Needed as input for DFT geometry optimization.

resources.name: List of reactions for free energy and rate constant computation

access.notes: Provided as a text file listing each reaction (reactants → products) with a unique reaction ID.

resources.notes: Includes both the SiH4-C3H8-H2 reactions (for LFER) and the new SiCl4-C3H8-H2 reactions.
